{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with conversion errors (i.e., where revenue_numeric is NaN)
conversion_errors = sales_df[sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isnull()]

# Check if any of these error rows are in the 'completed' status
error_in_completed = conversion_errors[conversion_errors['status'] == 'completed']

# Print the number of conversion errors and how many are in completed orders
print("Total conversion errors:", len(conversion_errors))
print("Conversion errors in completed orders:", len(error_in_completed))

# Now, filter for completed orders and compute mean revenue
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print("Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding invalid revenue entries):", mean_revenue_completed)"}
